plate_comment: The lift pump (logical output 53, e2m Lift_Pump_Driver; DRB test 13-33 'FUEL PUMP RELAY / TRANSFER PUMP'). With lift_pump_override_enable set it drives lift_pump_override_state. Otherwise it requests the pump while the engine runs (lift_pump_run_reason 2) or cranks (3), and with the engine stopped it counts lift_pump_engine_stopped_time (0.1 s) and drops the pump after the reason's run time: after key-on (35 s here), after cranking (20 s) or after running (0 s) (was protection_ambient_qualification)

Key-on start of the lift pump control: lift_pump_run_reason = 1 (key on), lift_pump_engine_stopped_time = 0 and the lift pump requested (logical output 53), so the pump primes for lift_pump_run_time_after_key_on (was protection_exception_event_35_init)
